summary: Customer Experience Phase verification — backend + frontend. Backend: 14/14 tests in tests/test_customer_experience_phase.py pass. Live endpoint checks confirmed: GET /api/checkout/order/{o}/status without token → 422; wrong token → 404 with only {code:'NOT_FOUND'} (no fields leak); POST /api/admin/orders/{o}/mark-shipped without auth → 403; with bad JWT → 401; with valid admin JWT (server.create_token('admin')) + nonexistent order → 404 NOT_FOUND; with extra body field → 422 (extra=forbid). Broader regression: 957 pass / 2 fail (annie-rose-foundation gold-spot drift is documented pre-existing; adaptive_pricing_live_integration::test_canonical_order_stays_usd_with_cad is a live-Stripe-session env-dependent test previously not-rerun per iteration_18 instruction). Frontend: /ring-size-guide renders with ring-size-guide-page, ring-size-chart, ring-size-row-7 (row: 7 · 54 · N½ · 17.3 mm) — chart has US/EU/UK/mm columns and ZERO resizing-policy language. /orders/PHI-DOES-NOT-EXIST/status without token → renders order-status-unauthorized (title 'PHILEON — Order PHI-DOES-NOT-EXIST', no 'token' word or raw token in body). With bogus token → same order-status-unauthorized state; raw token string 'bogus-abc-123' NOT in body or title; word 'token' not visible in page content. /checkout/success renders both without a sessionStorage token and with — the sessionStorage-backed link surfaces data-testid=checkout-view-order-status → /orders/{o}/status?token=... /checkout/cancel renders fine. NOTE (naming discrepancy, not a functional bug): the review spec asked for data-testid=ring-size-guide-cta/ring-size-guide-link on ring PDPs, but the implementation prefixes per-product — on /ovation the actual testids are 'ovation-ringsize-guide-cta' and 'ovation-ringsize-guide-link' (RingSizeSelector.jsx uses `${testIdPrefix}-guide-cta`; OvationRibbedRingPage passes 'ovation-ringsize'). Every ring PDP therefore emits `<prefix>-guide-cta` / `<prefix>-guide-link` rather than the flat 'ring-size-guide-*' asked for. Functionality is intact (link navigates to /ring-size-guide, is rendered beside the RingSizeSelector).
action_items: OPTIONAL / naming-only: review spec listed data-testid='ring-size-guide-cta' and 'ring-size-guide-link' as the exact testids on ring PDPs. Actual emitted testids are per-product-prefixed (e.g. 'ovation-ringsize-guide-cta'). If flat naming is required for external QA tooling, either (a) hardcode testIdPrefix to 'ring-size' in RingSizeSelector consumers, or (b) update the spec/PRD to accept the `${prefix}-guide-cta` pattern. No functional impact — CTA renders and navigates correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes/admin_orders.py mark-shipped uses find_one_and_update as an atomic gate on `shipping_notification_sent: {$ne: True}` before sending the email — this is the correct idempotency primitive; confirmed by test_mark_shipped_first_call_sends_email_second_is_noop (single email fires across duplicate calls).

backend/routes/checkout.py order_status projects an explicit whitelist rather than blacklisting internal keys, which is the safer default. Verified via test_order_status_does_not_leak_internal_fields — none of id, idempotency_key, provider_session_id, provider_payment_intent_id, webhook_event_ids, status_token_hash, presentment, fx_rate, fx_rate_source appear in response.

OrderStatusPage.jsx correctly derives visible copy without ever rendering the raw token — page title is 'PHILEON — Order {orderNumber}' with no token substring; body copy uses 'confirmation email' phrasing instead of 'token'.

Pre-existing: tests/test_adaptive_pricing_live_integration.py::test_canonical_order_stays_usd_with_cad returned no `currency` field, likely because the stripe session response shape changed. Recommend either mocking Stripe (like the other tests) or gating this behind a live-integration marker so CI can skip it.
